prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original production 2D RPG VFX ANIMATION SHEET on genuinely transparent RGBA. Attached approved JOKRO artwork is reference only for emerald light and the fierce antlered Eastern dragon design. No human, clothing, physical sword, city, text, watermark, grid lines, black rectangles or backdrop. Opaque dark jade material cores with luminous mint/emerald edges and native soft alpha only at glow edges. No gold recolor, no pale fog covering the full cell.
EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 SQUARE cells, ordered left-to-right/top-to-bottom, ideal2048x1536. Fixed camera and visual anchor, generous15% EMPTY transparent padding around every frame. All tips, embers and whiskers completely inside their own cell. Each frame must have genuinely evolving shapes; not repeated scaled copies.
SEQUENCE: A seamless12-frame emerald scale-and-flame AURA LOOP. Tilted elliptical ring seen in three-quarter perspective, hollow transparent center for a standing warrior. Braided viridian dragon scales and emerald flame filaments circulate, front lower arc stronger and rear upper arc raised. Each cell redraws small flame tongues and light branches as energy travels around ring; similar overall envelope so it loops smoothly back to first. No dragon head. Strong clear green, controlled white hot edges. This is permanent aura, not explosion.
